question:
**Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

A person who has money especially invested in business
solution:
The correct answer is: **Capitalist**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word '**capitalist**' refers to a person who has money invested in business. (पूंजीवादी)
 
• It comes from the word 'capital', which means wealth or money.
 
• A capitalist is someone who believes in the economic system of capitalism, where businesses are privately owned and operated for profit.
 
• Examples of famous capitalists include Warren Buffet, Elon Musk, and Bill Gates.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Industrialist **refers to a person who owns or manages an industry or industries. (उद्योगपति)
 
• **Minimalist **refers to a person who advocates for living with minimal possessions and focusing on simplicity. (न्यूनतमवाद)
 
• **Leftist **refers to a person who holds political views that are left-wing or socialist in nature. (वाम-पंथी)
